regionalFindings: WDM currently exposes 260 open MedTech listings across its employer register; current feed includes development, simulation, software, regulatory and quality roles.
Life Science Nord currently lists regional MedTech/life-science vacancies including Product Design Engineer and lab-automation software roles.
Jobware currently exposes MedTech engineering results and has an explicit 0-year entry-level filter.
Bund.de currently exposes health/science/technology vacancies and BfArM-related roles.
Direct employer ATS sweeps added KBR, Medtronic, BD, INTU Diagnostics, SINGULUS and Agaplesion/AMTech to the employer target universe.
limitations: No new vacancy is promoted to the published set without a tier-1 to tier-3 verification path.
Candidate work authorization remains a separate gate and was not inferred.
Some aggregator discoveries require primary employer confirmation before publication.
policyUpdate: Work authorization is a separate verification dimension. Unknown authorization does not suppress a potentially relevant research finding; it is included with an explicit WORK_AUTHORIZATION_VERIFY flag. Final publication still requires separate authorization verification.

workAuthorizationHandling.rule: Do not infer authorization from Germany location, employer, job board, or degree location.
